convert_vrs_to_mp4: convert a VRS recording file to an MP4 video with optional audio channels and downsampling
run_vrs_to_mp4_cli: run the vrs_to_mp4 CLI tool to convert a VRS file to MP4 with a specified stream ID
parse_vrs_to_mp4_args: parse command line arguments for VRS to MP4 conversion including stream ID and audio channels
convert_vrs_rgb_stream: convert the default RGB stream 214-1 from a VRS file to an MP4 video
convert_vrs_with_audio: convert a VRS file to MP4 with specific audio channel indices from the glasses microphones
